events.title: 🌙 Demo 1.0 – Bug Fixes
events.summary: 🔧 Startup / Intro Fixes Some players were unable to progress past the beginning of the game due to shaders not loading correctly on certain configurations. These shaders are now included directly in the build, which should fix the issue.🎨 Graphics Settings Improvements Graphics quality settings now have a more noticeable impact, and brightness adjustments have been improved.🖥️ VSync Fix Fixed an issue where VSync was sometimes not applied correctly.Thanks again to everyone who sent reports and P

events.title: Last Moon Demo 1.0 is OUT NOW! 🌙
events.summary: What’s new in Demo 1.0?⚔️ Reworked gameplay and game feel Combat, controls, feedback and progression have received a lot of improvements.📖 Improved narration & new NPCs The beginning of the adventure has been heavily reworked, with new characters, dialogue and a much stronger introduction to the world of Eterna.✨ Runes, skills & progression New systems give you more ways to customize your playstyle and build.🎨 Major visual improvements Environments, effects, animations, UI and many other details

events.title: Keyboard and mouse controls upgraded !
events.summary: Hello everyone! Here is a new demo update to improve mouse/keyboard gameplay! Indeed, it was problematic that the character always attacked towards the mouse cursor in this configuration. Thank you for your constructive feedback which allows me to improve the game with each new update :)! patch note: - Improved keyboard/mouse controls - Reduced "bullet time" in co-op mode - Fixed some minor bugs reported by players Thank you for your awesome feedbacks and good game to all! - Vincent -

events.title: Last Moon' demo is live!
events.summary: Hello everyone, TODAY, Last Moon was featured in the PC Gaming Show, and we're excited to announce that the demo is AVAILABLE NOW. We hope you will enjoy the adventure as much as we enjoyed building it, and we can't wait to hear what you think about it! Enjoy the first minutes of Last Moon's gameplay, alone or with a friend, in the local Co-op mode available from the first firecamp! We are already waiting for your feedback on the dedicated topic on Steam Forum: https://steamcommunity.com/app/110
